'''Operation Banshee''' was part of the campaign against the [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|''Gauntlet'' superweapon]] by the [[Republic Special Forces Division]]. After the [[Safecrackers]] demolition unit got bogged down fighting in the [[Quesh war]] in [[Quesh]], General [[Elin Garza]] sent the [[Havoc Squad]] to retrieve them for the upcoming [[Battle of the Gauntlet]]. After arriving on Quesh and meeting with Major [[Donovan (major)|Donovan]], [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Havoc Squad Lieutenant]] led the assault against an Imperial Command Bunker that provided the Safecrackers with the necessary break to exfiltrate.<ref name="TOR" />
